s: MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS General The Company’s business is focused on enhancement of adherence to disease and health care management programs through artificial intelligence, machine learning, patient monitoring and improved communications.
